chalk-badges-reel.summary: A green gridded chalkboard with drifting chalk dust. Two script words are chalked in left to right around an ornate ampersand with three yellow sparkles, then wiped away. The company name appears small across the top and a sticker sheet of six chalk badges fills the board in a three by two grid: a script word with a looping swash and coral sparkles, capitals on lilac tape, capitals on a coral starburst, serif capitals on a sky blue ribbon, a script word in a yellow speech bubble and hand capitals in a ring with coral rays. The sheet holds while sparkles twinkle, then the words wipe off, the tape and ribbon fade into the board and the starburst shrinks away as pale chalk dust. Three badges are then drawn big one at a time in the centre (tape, starburst, ribbon by default), each held fully written for about two thirds of a second before it wipes away. The company name fades from the top as the reel ends on a branded end card: the logo on a light plate, a small and a big chunky yellow headline line, a tagline and the website underlined in coral, held for about 1.7 seconds before it fades clean for the loop.
